source: NASA/JPL Horizons API: heliocentric ecliptic J2000 (ICRF) positions in au, TDB; uncertainties in km
sigmaNote:
sigma: Horizons' formal 1-sigma position uncertainty at sigmaJd (VEC_TABLE 1xa). Horizons explains:
X_s    X-direction 1-sigma position uncertainty (km)                     
      Y_s    Y-direction 1-sigma position uncertainty (km)                     
      Z_s    Z-direction 1-sigma position uncertainty (km)                     
      A_s    Along-track direction 1-sigma position uncertainty (km)
      C_s    Cross-track direction 1-sigma position uncertainty (km)
      N_s    Normal direction 1-sigma position uncertainty (km)
